title: Automation keeps its tier after its accountable maintainer steps down
description: From vouch-ey47.13 review. Implemented (Claude, for Mark's review): the accountable's claim must be maintainer/anchor at the commit that added the bot's tier record (else error); if the accountable later has no valid maintainer/anchor tier, the bot's tier record is VOID (warning, check exits 0, bot has no tier until re-assigned). Alternative: pure D6 analogue, bot keeps its tier after the accountable steps down. Owner's call: is accountability ongoing (current) or judged at approval like the approver?
acceptance_criteria: Fixture: accountable maintainer's tier deleted after the bot's tier record; check passes with no void for the bot and export still lists the bot's file-namespace key. Real ssh-keygen signatures, real git history.
notes: DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22): judged at approval like D6. The accountable must be maintainer/anchor at the commit that added the bot's tier record (else error, as now); if the accountable later steps down, the bot KEEPS its tier. Change current code, which voids the bot's tier record; update tests and DESIGN.md.
